areas.note: Approximate research outline around the Third Avenue corridor. A 1964 folklore record names Third between West Fort and Bagley; it does not define lateral boundaries. This outline is an interpretive selection area, not a cadastral boundary.
areas.baseline_note: 1921 simplified footprints registered to three street-intersection controls. Historical and present-day streets can differ. Control-point fit is not a survey accuracy claim; building heights remain illustrative.

buildings.geometry_basis: Synthetic teaching footprint; not a historical reconstruction

method: Map outlines, markers, tracing and dimensions are research approximations. Photo markers describe supported subject or camera locations as labeled. A source date is not proof of conditions in the requested year.
roadPhysicalReviewMethod: Each road segment has separate observation, opening, legal action and removal fields. Null means unknown. Year-end timeline convention; the earliest dated map is not an opening date. New freeway evidence is linked in the inspector only; unregistered aerials do not supply invented ramp geometry.
transportMethod: Station service dates, construction dates, and physical removal dates are distinct. Source-traced 1950 rail-fan geometry, agency reference corridors and illustrative rail elevations are individually identified. Current water/border geometry is a navigation reference, not historical shoreline reconstruction.
roadConnectionMethod: Named network continuations and tangent extensions fill modeled gaps without establishing verified historical junctions. Reference centerlines and corridor dates are retained separately. Grade-separated I-94 crossing is schematic in height; remaining road grades and ramps are unresolved.
